name: overview-loads
title: Overview tab loads and shows net worth
body: The Overview tab is the app's landing page. For the demo dataset it should render a net-worth summary and allocation visuals without errors or blank states. Take a screenshot, read the Overview, scroll if needed to confirm the allocation visual, then report.

criteria.text: The Overview shows a clearly-labeled net-worth figure (a money amount).
The page is not blank or stuck on a spinner — real content (cards/charts) is visible.
An allocation / breakdown visual (chart or bands) is present.
